claims: The third round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday.
The fourth round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday.
Paramount+ and Masters.com provide coverage of the third round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 12 p.m.–2 p.m. ET.
CBS and Paramount+ provide coverage of the third round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m.–7 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ and Masters.com provide coverage of the fourth round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 12 p.m.–2 p.m. ET.
CBS and Paramount+ provide coverage of the fourth round of the 2026 Masters Tournament from 2 p.m.–7 p.m. ET.
Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+ offer dedicated streams for Featured Groups all weekend.
Masters.com, Masters App, and Paramount+ offer dedicated streams for Amen Corner (Holes 11, 12, 13) all weekend.
Coverage of Holes 4, 5, 6 and 15, 16 is available.
Hulu + Live TV carries CBS coverage.
